採用・広告の製品.quote: Our governance layer gives humans and agents assurance that all transactions are executed safely within the bounds of predefined, deterministic policies.
From payroll and procurement to sales and treasury, agents can now handle money. Catena gives them a way to do it safely. Your team sets the rules. Agents execute within them.
Your payroll agent reads contracts, processes invoices, and pays engineers around the world, using stablecoins or fiat currencies.
Your procurement agent finds suppliers, verifies their agents’ identities, negotiates terms, and secures contracts matched to your needs.
Agents use the MCP server, skills, API, and CLI. Humans stay in charge of policies and approvals using a personal agent or the web console.
Go through this list of contractor invoices and prepare them all for payment.
AI agents are entering the financial system. Without proper governance, that's a risk.

We're a team of engineers, designers, data scientists, finance professionals, and AI agents creating financial infrastructure and services that will transform the global economic system.

Launch your own branded fintech product on our proven stack — cards, accounts, payments, custody, all configurable.
Production-grade accounts, cards, payments, and lending built on the rails your customers already use.
Stablecoins, tokenized deposits, and real-world assets — including production deployments like Unitoken.
Our team designs, develops, and ships in weekly cycles. You see real progress every week, not at the end.
We handle deployment, compliance, and ongoing improvements — or hand the codebase off cleanly to your team.
We build to the same regulatory standards your risk team already uses — and prepare for the ones coming next.
Modern stacks, clean APIs, and sandbox environments that actually behave like production. Whether we own the codebase or hand it to your team, the standard is the same.

2025年5月に$18Mのシード（a16z crypto主導）でステルスを脱し、2026年5月に$30MのシリーズA（Acrew Capital・a16z crypto主導）。国のトラスト銀行チャーターを申請している。
立ち上げ時に、オープンソースの Agent Commerce Kit（ACK）を公開した。エージェントの身元の ACK-ID と、支払いフローの ACK-Pay。
芯は、規制されたレールこそAIネイティブなマネーの前提だ、という立場。既存の決済網とつなぎながら、規制されたステーブルコインへ橋渡しする。

AIに銀行口座は作れない──Catenaが解く問題
銀行業は「お金を預かり、本人確認・貸し出し審査・送金・法令順守を一括で引き受ける仕事」だ。本人確認(KYC=Know Your Customer)は犯罪資金の洗浄(マネーロンダリング)を防ぐため身分証で実在を確かめる法的義務で、人間でも法人でもないAIエージェントは原則として口座を開けない。Catena Labs はAI専用の口座とIDを発行し、預かりと送金を自社で完結させる方針をとった。
